questions.stem: An 8-month-old girl is brought to the paediatric outpatient department by her mother because of bilateral lower limb and abdomen swelling. Physical examination reveals peripheral oedema and hepatomegaly. On auscultation, a loud systolic ejection murmur is heard in the pulmonary area, and the pulmonic component of S2 is not audible. What is the most likely diagnosis?
